effects: The signer sends exactly `assets` WBTC to the vault, which supplies it to Morpho Blue markets.
The vault mints pWBTC shares to `receiver`. The number of shares comes from the vault's share price at execution (floor rounding), after fee shares go to the fee recipient.
formats.shown: Deposit: the WBTC amount, the share ticker pWBTC as a constant, and the receiver of the shares.

findings.title: deposit: the shares minted come from the vault's price and cannot be shown.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.sol deposit(): shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor). This is not in calldata, and there is no minShares parameter.
findings.fix: None in ERC-7730. It is inherent to ERC-4626 deposit.

findings.title: deposit: the intent is just 'Deposit', with no interpolatedIntent naming the amount or receiver.
findings.evidence: descriptor deposit format: "intent": "Deposit", no interpolatedIntent. The field 'Share ticker' shows the raw constant pWBTC as a separate line.
findings.fix: Add interpolatedIntent "Deposit {assets} for pWBTC shares to {receiver}" and drop the raw 'Share ticker' field.

effects: The signer pays WBTC to the vault. The amount comes from the vault's share price at execution (ceil rounding), and calldata has no maximum.
The vault mints exactly `shares` pWBTC to `receiver`.
The WBTC is supplied to Morpho Blue markets.
formats.shown: Mint: deposit asset WBTC (ticker only, no amount), the exact pWBTC shares minted, and the receiver of the shares.

findings.title: mint: the WBTC paid is computed on chain and has no bound, so the screen shows no amount.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.sol mint(): assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil). Case 0: the signer sent 101 WBTC sats (signer out), and the screen shows only 'Deposit asset: WBTC'.
findings.fix: None possible: there is no maxAssets parameter. Wording such as 'WBTC (amount set by vault price)' would at least flag it.

findings.title: mint: the intent 'Mint' does not say WBTC is paid in exchange.
findings.evidence: descriptor mint format: "intent": "Mint", interpolatedIntent null. In case 0 the blind reader was unsure how much WBTC would leave.
findings.fix: Use the intent 'Deposit WBTC for shares' and an interpolatedIntent "Mint {shares} to {receiver} by paying WBTC".

cases.notes: The signer paid 101 WBTC sats. The screen names WBTC but no amount, so the reader got the direction and asset but not the amount. The 0.000000999 pWBTC minted to 0xdead is shown correctly but is not a signer effect.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address owner)
effects: Exactly `assets` WBTC is withdrawn from Morpho markets and sent to `receiver`.
pWBTC shares are burned from `owner`. The number comes from the vault price (ceil rounding).
If `owner` is not the signer, the signer's allowance on owner's pWBTC is spent.
formats.shown: Withdraw: the exact WBTC amount, the receiver, and the owner whose shares are burned.

findings.title: withdraw: the pWBTC shares burned come from the vault's price and cannot be shown.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.sol withdraw(): shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil). This is not in calldata, and there is no maxShares parameter.

findings.title: withdraw: the intent 'Withdraw' does not say that vault shares are burned to pay for it.
findings.fix: Add interpolatedIntent "Withdraw {assets} to {receiver} by burning shares of {owner}".

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address owner)
effects: Exactly `shares` pWBTC are burned from `owner`, spending the signer's allowance if the owner is not the signer.
WBTC is withdrawn from Morpho markets and sent to `receiver`. The amount comes from the vault price (floor rounding), and calldata has no minimum.
formats.shown: Redeem: the exact pWBTC shares, the receiver and the owner. It does not name the asset received or its amount.

findings.title: redeem: the WBTC received is computed on chain and has no minimum, so no amount is shown.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.sol redeem(): assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor). Case 1: the signer received 4016 WBTC sats (signer in), and no field states it.
findings.fix: None for the amount: there is no minAssets parameter.

findings.title: redeem: the screen never names WBTC as the asset received, unlike the mint format.
findings.evidence: descriptor redeem fields: only shares, receiver, owner. The mint format includes the constant underlyingTicker. In case 1 the blind reader said 'probably WBTC' and was unsure of the asset.
findings.fix: Add a field 'Receive asset' with value $.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker, and an interpolatedIntent "Redeem {shares} for WBTC to {receiver}".

cases.notes: The pWBTC burn (0.000039939714750802) is shown exactly. The 4016 WBTC sats received are not shown, and the reader guessed the asset with no amount.
